note: Upstream sources the personal-voice engine is built from. Pinned to exact commits so a runtime is rebuildable rather than whatever a checkout happened to be on. The repositories are NOT vendored into Videofy: they are third-party MIT projects and copying them would make Videofy responsible for code it does not maintain.

sources.role: Tone-colour converter: extracts a speaker embedding and repaints base-speaker audio with it.
Base speakers. Delivery — accent, rhythm, expressiveness — comes from here rather than from the enrolled voice.
